You are helping an advisor at a small independent advisory firm. This folder holds the records of every client household of the firm as they stood on 15 April 2026, one folder per household under households/<household ID>/, each with the custodian's files (custodian/), the firm's portfolio system (portfolio/) and its CRM (crm/).

The advisor asks: which IRA owners in the book had a 2025 required minimum distribution, from any of their retirement accounts, that was not met?

Work only from these files. End your answer with one fenced json block with these fields:
- "finding": "found" if one or more owners did, "none_found" if none did, or "unresolved" if the files settle no household as found and leave some unresolved
- "households": one entry per household with such an owner, each as {"household_id": ..., "owner_id": the owner's person ID, "account_ids": the accounts the unmet distribution had to come from, "shortfall": the amount not taken, "explanation": one sentence}, or [] if none
- "unresolved": the households the files cannot settle, each as {"household_id": ..., "explanation": one sentence}, or [] if none
- "figures": every figure you relied on from the files, each as {"label": ..., "value": ..., "source": the file it came from, relative to this folder}, adding "computed": true to a figure you computed from them rather than read
- "explanation": two or three sentences
